teaser.en: The Digo saw a crocodile's backbone in its leaves: 'mongo wa mbulu'.
teaser.sw: Wadigo waliona uti wa mgongo wa mamba katika majani yake: 'mongo wa mbulu'.
teaser.dg: Adigo aona mongo wa mamba kpwenye makodzage: *mongo wa mbulu*.

summary.en: *Mongo wa mbulu* is a woody climber of forest edges with winged leaf stalks and bright red, three-lobed seed capsules. Its name compares the leaf to a crocodile's backbone.
summary.sw: *Mongo wa mbulu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu wa kando ya misitu, wenye vikonyo vya majani vyenye mabawa na vifuko vya mbegu vyekundu vyenye pande tatu. Jina lake linalinganisha jani na uti wa mgongo wa mamba.
summary.dg: *Mongo wa mbulu* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye muhi mufu, unaomera kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Milita ya makodzage ina mapha, na makakayage ga tembe ni ga kundu sana na gana seemu tahu. Dzinare rinahalanisha kodza na mongo wa mamba.

about.en:
*Mongo wa mbulu* is a woody climber that pulls itself up with coiled tendrils. Its compound leaves have a distinctive winged stalk: the midrib between the leaflets is edged with a flat green flange, so the leaf looks ridged and segmented.

The fruits are red, three-lobed capsules. When they split, they show black seeds partly wrapped in a white fleshy coat, so that they look like small staring eyes.
about.sw:
*Mongo wa mbulu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu unaojivuta juu kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja vya kushikilia. Majani yake yenye vijani vingi yana kikonyo cha pekee chenye mabawa: mshipa mkuu kati ya vijani umepakana na ukingo bapa wa kijani, kwa hivyo jani huonekana kuwa na matuta na kugawanyika kwa pingili.

Matunda ni vifuko vyekundu vyenye pande tatu. Vinapopasuka, huonyesha mbegu nyeusi zilizofunikwa kwa sehemu na ganda jeupe lenye nyama, hivi kwamba zinaonekana kama macho madogo yanayokodolea.
about.dg:
*Mongo wa mbulu* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye muhi mufu, unaokpwera dzulu kpwa nyuzi zinazolinga-linga. Makodzage ni makodza madide manji ganayolungana, na mlita wa kodza una alama ya kumanyikira: bati riro kahi ya makodza madide rina mapha ga chijani ga sambamba kanda-kanda zosi mbiri, kpwa hivyo kodza rinaonekana dza rina misitari na rinaganyika vipande-vipande.

Matundage ni makakaya ga kundu genye seemu tahu. Ganaphoahuka, ganaonyesa tembe nyiru zirizofwinikpwa nusu ni nyama nyereru, kpwa hivyo zinaonekana dza matso madide ganayolola.

where.en: Look for *mongo wa mbulu* on forest edges, where it climbs over shrubs and small trees. The red capsules are the easiest feature to spot.
where.sw: Mtafute *mongo wa mbulu* kando ya misitu, ambako hupanda juu ya vichaka na miti midogo. Vifuko vyekundu ndiyo sifa rahisi zaidi kuiona.
where.dg: Hendza *mongo wa mbulu* kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ambapho unakpwera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi midide. Makakaya ga kundu ndigo ganayoonekana kpwa urahisi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mongo wa mbulu* means 'backbone of the crocodile', after the shape of the leaf, whose winged, segmented midrib recalls a crocodile's ridged back.
culture.sw: Jina *mongo wa mbulu* linamaanisha 'uti wa mgongo wa mamba', kutokana na umbo la jani, ambalo mshipa wake mkuu wenye mabawa na pingili unakumbusha mgongo wa mamba wenye matuta.
culture.dg: Dzina *mongo wa mbulu* manage ni 'mongo wa mamba', kpwa sababu ya umbo ra kodza: bati rakpwe renye mapha na vipande-vipande rinatambukiza mongo wa mamba wenye misitari.

names.en: Digo: *mongo wa mbulu*, 'backbone of the crocodile'. No English or Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Paullinia pinnata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mongo wa mbulu*, 'uti wa mgongo wa mamba'. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Paullinia pinnata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mongo wa mbulu*, 'mongo wa mamba'. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Paullinia pinnata*.
